sn12.19:3.1: tatra → tatra hi (bj) | adhippayāso kiṁ nānākaraṇaṁ → adhippāyaso kinnānākaraṇaṁ (sya-all)
sn12.19:3.2: bhagavaṁmūlakā → bhagavammūlakā (bj) | bhagavaṁnettikā bhagavaṁpaṭisaraṇā → bhagavannettikā bhagavampaṭisaraṇā (bj) | bhagavantaṁyeva → bhagavantaññeva (bj) | vata → vata me (sya-all)
sn12.19:6.7: adhippayāso → adhippāyo (bj) | adhippayāso idaṁ nānākaraṇaṁ → adhippāyaso idannānākaraṇaṁ (sya-all)
